messages:
Alex W: Heads up — PR #4021 (migration-guide update) is blocked by docs CI. Preview failing on linkcheck + Vale rules. Preview: https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/pr/4021 :eyes:
CI Bot: build/preview failed for PR 4021
- linkcheck: 2 errors
- vale: 1 error (prose/avoid-contractions)
Logs:```
linkcheck: ./content/migration/v1-to-v2.md:54 -> /api/old-endpoint (404)
linkcheck: ./content/migration/v1-to-v2.md:87 -> https://external.example.com/redwood-runtime (410)
vale: ./content/migration/v1-to-v2.md:120 -> "can't" flagged by prose/avoid-contractions
```
Maria P: I can handle the internal link. Looks like we should point to /api/v2/serve instead of /api/old-endpoint. Also add a note about the external link being removed (410) and replace with archived doc or example snippet.
Samir: I can take the Vale fix (contractions). New rule landed in our style config yesterday and it's catching several PRs. Will search/replace contractions in this file.
Alex W: Thanks. Quick question on merge timing — we're trying to get this into the docs main before tomorrow's release notes cut. Can we make the 10:30am merge window today?
Jen L: I'm around for review at 10:20. I can do content review but need CI green to approve. If you think linkfix + contraction patches are small we can do a dry-run merge to staging first.
Maria P: Pushed link fix in commit abc123 (branch: docs/pr-4021-linkfix). Diff:```diff
- See /api/old-endpoint for the v1 behavior.
+ See /api/v2/serve for the v2 behavior (old endpoint removed).
```
Docs Bot: Preview redeployed for PR 4021: https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/pr/4021 — linkcheck now reports 1 error, vale still failing.
Samir: Pushed Vale fix in commit def456 (branch: docs/pr-4021-vale). Reworded the contraction at line ~120: "cannot" instead of "can't", tightened phrasing a bit. Also ran `prettier --check` to avoid formatter diffs.
CI Bot: Re-run results for PR 4021:
- linkcheck: passed
- vale: passed
- markdownlint: warning - line-length in migration page (rule MD013) — not blocking
All checks: ✅ green (except warnings)
Alex W: Excellent. Scheduling merge into docs-main at 10:30am slot. @Jen L please LGTM when you have a sec. I'll hold the merge until you confirm. :thumbsup:
Jen L: LGTM. Quick read-through looked good, no content regressions.
Alex W: Merging now. Thanks for the quick fixes — release notes will include the migration note.
Docs Bot: PR 4021 merged into docs-main by Alex W at 10:33am.
